tests.initial_fixture_corrections: A synthetic growth example accidentally satisfied the old census; changed births/claims2to3. An interaction expectation used algebraically equivalent floating ordering; switched assertion to absolute1e-14 tolerance. No accountant change was required.

proofs.census: R_BIRTH/R_DEATH always update terminal census; birth/death/kill counters are gated by t>=t_open. Initial-cell census cannot be inferred from measured-window counters.
proofs.receptors: R_RCAND candidate/accept counters share cnt gating; R_RECEPT delivery may arrive after opening from earlier candidate. Accept<=candidate retained, delivery<=accept removed.
proofs.morph: R_CHEM/R_LOST and terminal morph mass are not t_open-gated; whole-life mass conservation remains valid.
proofs.guard: close_life and ABI.guard_charge use c_live*n_max*(end−t_end), including before opening.
proofs.extinction: LifeEvaluator.columns clips counted remaining time at max(t_ext,t0+t_open), then divides by T−t_open.
proofs.freeze: F_FREEZE prevents new claims/apoptosis/GRN/phenotype/effective-weight updates; bounded pre-fork claim/notices resolve before544. Composition/live-time checks only complete guard-free frozen pairs; all scientific rows retained.

limits: Source-only component; full protocol/source/seed/resource closure reader remains separate.
Lateral-off changes downstream network and motor dynamics; this is not a memory-specific intervention.
